from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, struct

payload = Path('/Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/evidence/CF-6770ec9eab360cb26b321688/chg255-r4/artifact/worktree/visual-atlas/chg255-r4')
proof_dir = payload / 'settings-coincident'
pair_manifest = json.loads((proof_dir / 'coincident-pair-manifest.json').read_text())
assert pair_manifest['pairCount'] == 4
verified_pairs = []

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def png_chunks(data):
    assert data[:8] == b'\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n'
    pos = 8
    while pos < len(data):
        n = struct.unpack('>I', data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        kind = data[pos+4:pos+8]
        payload = data[pos+8:pos+8+n]
        yield kind, payload
        pos += 12+n
        if kind == b'IEND':
            break

for entry in pair_manifest['pairs']:
    jpath = proof_dir / entry['files']['json']
    ppath = proof_dir / entry['files']['png']
    record = json.loads(jpath.read_text())
    assert sha(jpath) == entry['sha256']['json']
    assert sha(ppath) == entry['sha256']['png']
    assert record['proofId'] == entry['proofId']
    assert record['accepted'] is True
    actual_envelope = []
    for kind, chunk_data in png_chunks(ppath.read_bytes()):
        if kind == b'iTXt' and chunk_data.startswith(b'sysgrid-proof\\x00'):
            keyword, rest = chunk_data.split(b'\\x00', 1)
            compression_flag, compression_method = rest[0], rest[1]
            assert compression_flag == 0 and compression_method == 0
            language, rest = rest[2:].split(b'\\x00', 1)
            translated, text = rest.split(b'\\x00', 1)
            assert language == b'' and translated == b''
            actual_envelope.append(json.loads(text.decode('utf-8')))
    expected_envelope = {'proofId': record['proofId'], 'stateMetadata': record['stateMetadata']}
    assert actual_envelope == [expected_envelope]
    assert entry['pngEmbeddedMetadataExactMatch'] is True
    verified_pairs.append({'proofId': entry['proofId'], 'scope': entry['scope'], 'jsonSha256': sha(jpath), 'pngSha256': sha(ppath), 'stateMetadataSha256': entry['stateMetadataSha256']})

files = []
for path in sorted(p for p in payload.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name "'!= '"'MANIFEST.json'):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    files.append({'path': path.relative_to(payload).as_posix(), 'sizeBytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
manifest = {
    'schema': 'sysgrid-chg255-r4-verification-artifact-manifest-v1',
    'repository': 'kimhw8084/sysgrid',
    'request': 'sysgrid-golden-ui-v3-atlas-blockers-verify-v4',
    'candidate': {'commit': 'ecad9edd993c4022f4716e1e4099bc2dad29c4a0', 'tree': '15332211fe6c39f5f3926ebc970a3c0ece362d83'},
    'artifactParent': '72712e2bded0f49f2040715786e2f3133b622eb8',
    'fileCountExcludingManifest': len(files),
    'files': files,
    'settingsPairsReadbackVerified': verified_pairs,
    'conclusion': 'GO_READY_EVIDENCE'
}
(payload / 'MANIFEST.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\\n')
